description: A set of toggles. Pick one (type="single") like a category filter, or several at once (type="multiple").

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: type="multiple": several items can be on at the same time.

spacing.title: With Spacing
spacing.description: spacing adds space between items (1 = 4px). spacing=0 joins the items into one bar.

disabled.title: Disabled Item
disabled.description: Disable specific items, such as a fully booked session.

props.type: single = one choice, multiple = many choices.
props.value: Active items (controlled). An array when multiple.
props.spacing: Space between items in Tailwind units (1 = 4px).
